blocks.arabic_text: رَجُلٍ يَغْبَارُّ قَدَمَاهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ إِلَّا أَمَّنَ اللهُ قَدَمَيْهِ مِنَ النَّارِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Umamah Bahili (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Whoever's face becomes covered with dust in the path of Allah Ta'ala, Allah Ta'ala will certainly protect his face (from the fire of Jahannam) on the Day of Qiyamah. Whoever's feet become covered with dust in the path of Allah Ta'ala, Allah Ta'ala will (certainly) protect both his feet from the fire of Jahannam on the Day of Final Judgement.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: يَوْمٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ اَلْفِ يَوْمٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه النسائي، باب فضل الرباط، رقم:٣١٧٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Uthman ibn Affan (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say, “Spending one day in the path of Allah Ta'ala is better than spending a thousand days in what is other than the path of Allah.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: غَدْوَةٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ أَوْ رَوْحَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو بعض الحديث) رواه البخاري، باب صفة الجنة والنار، رقم:٦٥٦٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “(Going out for) one morning or one evening in the path of Allah Ta'ala is better than the world and all that is in it.”

blocks.text: Explanation: That is, even if the world and everything in it were spent in the path of Allah Ta'ala, going out for one morning or one evening in the path of Allah Ta'ala
